Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing the composition of a local health board in counties without a home rule charter.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to local health board composition; and amending RCW70.05.030.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.05.030 and 1995 c 43 s 6 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In counties without a home rule charter, the board of countycommissioners shall ((constitute the)) establish a local board ofhealth as provided in subsection (2) of this section, unless the countyis part of a health district pursuant to chapter 70.46 RCW. Thejurisdiction of the local board of health shall be coextensive with theboundaries of ((said)) the county. The board of county commissionersmay, at its discretion, adopt an ordinance expanding the size andcomposition of the board of health to include elected officials fromcities and towns and persons other than elected officials as members((so long as persons other than elected officials do not constitute amajority)). An ordinance adopted under this section shall includeprovisions for the appointment, term, and compensation, orreimbursement of expenses. (2) The local board of health must be comprised of the following: p. 1 SB 6939 (a)Two members of the board of county commissioners; (b) Two local physician representatives nominated by the countymedical society; (c) A local health care professional chosen by the board of countycommissioners; (d) Two local business representatives nominated by the localchamber of commerce, one representing the restaurant industry and onerepresenting the building industry; and (e) Two public members chosen by the board of county commissioners.
